request.description: One version with content, compiled items (with text hashes, frozen at submit), issues and the latest change request. Staff only. Consent templates are versioned config (same lifecycle as question sets): compliance makes, a different staff member approves in Change Requests, then compliance publishes. The document key is the context clients ask for (e.g. `journey`, `lead_capture`). Each item's text is hashed so a record proves exactly what the person saw.

response.name: 200 OK
